claims.text: Timer displays elapsed time in minutes and seconds format (MM:SS)
claims.details: The invariant ensures currentTime is always non-negative, which is required for valid MM:SS display. The ElapsedTimeNonNegative lemma also directly proves this property.

claims.text: A single tap or keypress creates a lap marker at the current elapsed time
claims.details: The CreateLap action in Apply creates a new lap at currentTime. The CreateLapPreservesExisting lemma proves existing laps are preserved when a new lap is created.

claims.text: Each lap records the duration from the previous lap marker (or start) to the current marker
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.LapDuration function with ensures LapDuration(laps, idx) >= 0
claims.details: The LapDuration function computes duration as laps[idx].timestamp - laps[idx-1].timestamp (or just timestamp for first lap), with a postcondition ensuring non-negative duration.

claims.text: Sessions are organized hierarchically: a Talk contains Sections, each Section contains one or more Takes
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.Lap datatype with section: string field
claims.details: The Lap datatype includes a section field for hierarchical organization. Laps with the same section name represent takes within that section.

claims.text: Each lap can be labeled with a section name after it is recorded
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.LabelLapOnlyChangesSection ensures: Apply(m, LabelLap(idx, name)).laps[idx].section == name
claims.details: The LabelLap action updates a lap's section field. The LabelLapOnlyChangesSection lemma proves the section is correctly assigned and timestamp is preserved.

claims.text: All takes are preserved with their timestamps and durations
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.LabelLapOnlyChangesSection ensures: Apply(m, LabelLap(idx, name)).laps[idx].timestamp == m.laps[idx].timestamp
claims.details: LabelLapOnlyChangesSection proves timestamps are preserved when labeling. CreateLapPreservesExisting proves existing laps are preserved when creating new ones.

claims.text: Each section automatically selects its best take (shortest duration) for total talk time calculation
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.BestTakeIsMinimum ensures: forall i | 0 <= i < |durations| :: durations[bestIdx] <= durations[i]
claims.details: The BestTakeIsMinimum lemma proves that selecting the minimum duration correctly identifies the best (shortest) take among all takes for a section.

claims.text: Total estimated talk duration is computed by summing the best take from each section
claims.details: The TotalDurationIsSumOfBestTakes lemma proves the total duration is the sum of best takes and is non-negative. Uses the Sum function and SumOfNonNegativeIsNonNegative helper lemma.

claims.text: All lap and label actions support undo and redo operations
claims.details: The Kernel module provides generic undo/redo via the Undo and Redo functions. UndoRedoRoundTrip and RedoUndoRoundTrip lemmas prove these operations are inverses of each other.

claims.text: The undo/redo stack preserves complete action history for the session
claims.details: The HistInv predicate represents history integrity. DoPreservesHistInv, UndoPreservesHistInv, and RedoPreservesHistInv lemmas prove all operations maintain valid history state.
